title: Hostile mobs
body:
Hey, can whoever.. blood.. exploded..?? here come.. retrieve their blood? Thanks.

Ew! What are you!? What!?

WHAT??

![image: Hostile mobs](media/1432793311688785972.png)

. . .

You may be wondering: how many hostile mobs are there in Disorder of the Stone?

Minecraft Alpha had 5 in total. Disorder of the Stone has bumped that up to 14.

Good luck, I think.
